class.name: NetwActionConfig
class.brief_description: How one action a node declared is predicted, and when the server runs it.
class.description: Every peer declares the action in [code]_init[/code] on the root node of a [NetwEntity], and each node keeps its own settings. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_action(place_bomb) \ .predict(ghost_bomb) \ .timing(NetwActionConfig.TIMING_TICK_ALIGNED_STATE_READY) [/codeblock]

method.name: confirm
method.description: Sets the method that runs on the peer that asked once the server ran the action. It receives the [Node] the [method predict] handler returned, or [code]null[/code]. With no handler set, that node is freed. [codeblock] func keep_bomb(ghost: Node) -> void: [/codeblock]

method.name: predict
method.description: Sets the method that runs on the peer that asked, inside [method Netw.action], with the action's arguments. It shows the action at once and returns a [Node], usually a placeholder, or [code]null[/code]. [codeblock] func ghost_bomb(pos: Vector2) -> Node: [/codeblock]

method.name: revert
method.description: Sets the method that runs on the peer that asked once the server denied the action or did not answer in time. It receives the [Node] the [method predict] handler returned, or [code]null[/code], with the code and the reason of [method NetwRequest.deny]. An action the server did not answer gives [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT] and an empty reason. With no handler set, that node is freed. [codeblock] func remove_bomb(ghost: Node, code: Error, reason: String) -> void: [/codeblock]

method.name: timeout_ticks
method.description: Sets how many ticks a request waits for the server's answer, where [code]0[/code] waits 120 ticks.

method.name: timing
method.description: Sets when the server runs the action, which is [constant TIMING_IMMEDIATE] until set.

constants.constant: Runs on the server when its tick reaches [member NetwActionRequest.view_tick].
Runs on the server once it has recorded the requesting entity's state at [member NetwActionRequest.view_tick], so the action sees the state the client saw.
Runs as soon as the request reaches the server.
